conflicts.quote: Architect does not add a wire field; PM/UX must not treat recency-true as Massive-live.
conflicts.why: That sentence is no longer defensible. The ticker already derives paid-live meaning (chip, pulses, fills) from the recency-true classifier. Process occupancy the client cannot read is copy-only, so replay ticks that satisfy wall recency occupy live Massive. present-is-live-paid-only and honesty-is-structural fail without consume-visible occupancy on the existing ticker path.
conflicts.proposal: Keep MarketDataPort as Live|Fixture and StreamEvent without a provenance member. The replay construct publishes closed consume occupancy on the existing hub/SSE path: stream basis is not paid-live; the paid-live classifier is false while armed; identity is the armed (symbol, et_date); tape cursor time is the stored stamp (not wall receive); phase is playing, gap, ended, or fault. Recency stays wall-clock for drop detection only. Same socket; not a third port kind.

conflicts.quote: End-of-tape / player drop degrades like an SSE gap (recency ages out); last Path-B snapshot remains.
conflicts.why: Collapsing end and drop into recency-age-out makes end-of-tape render as vendor-down. The existing consume watchdog treats hub silence as a live-stream drop. A Δt/k sleeper is silent between occupants, so waits longer than the watchdog look like drops even while the clock is still running.
conflicts.proposal: While the sleeper is running, publish non-tick playing occupancy/keep-alive on a period below the consume watchdog — no fabricated Trade/Quote. On last occupant, publish ended occupancy, then stop; do not loop. Last ReplayHold stays. RecvError/lag is drop, distinct from ended and from fault. Production serve still uses wall-clock recency as today.

conflicts.quote: Skip emit; occupancy already recorded the gap.
conflicts.why: Store-side AxisA/Path-A occupancy is not visible on the ticker consume path. Skip-without-signal makes a recorded PathAGap indistinguishable from watchdog silence, violating absent-is-not-none for gap vs drop vs ended.
conflicts.proposal: Still no interpolated ticks and no sleep on a ts-less PathAGap. When the cursor passes that slot (vec order between stamped neighbors — assumption: gap records sit in stored Path-A order), publish gap occupancy (non-tick), then sleep to the next stamped Trade/Quote. Unreadable DayContainer still refuses the whole start.

conflicts.quote: Start on Path-A zero shows `no path-a ticks for {SYMBOL} on {ET_DATE}` and refuses the walk.
conflicts.why: EmptyWhileStoring is already distinct from NoIdentity. Refusing start on Path-A count 0 blocks PM’s independent Path-B walk (Path-B Occupied, Path-A empty) and turns a kept quiet day into cannot-walk at the player boundary.
conflicts.proposal: NoIdentity / Unreadable / NotStoring / ineligible / not-elapsed / not-in-watchlist refuse with a silent hub. EmptyWhileStoring starts: zero Path-A Trade/Quote emits, Path-B marks still fire if Occupied, empty ≠ missing. Copy may use the capture empty literal; the clock still runs.

conflicts.quote: `/_ops/replay` is a **second unlinked operator route**, same chrome family as metrics (own AppBar, off `AppShell`, not in TopNav).
conflicts.why: Exclusive construct loads one DayContainer at process start and is the sole publisher; vendor worker and Path-A capture stay unspawned. A Start control that names (symbol, et_date) after bind is runtime arming — a catalog or live↔tape hot-switch, both rejected. PM already locked process-start and listed a `/_ops` walker as Out.
conflicts.proposal: Identity and k are construct arguments. Production-profile plus arm refuses startup. No HTTP Start/Stop that arms, disarms, or re-identifies the player this slice. Take UX’s CLI-only out: operator standing on process/CLI; S1 ticker honesty remains.

conflicts.quote: Architect does not add a wire field; PM/UX must not treat recency-true as Massive-live.
conflicts.why: The existing ticker already treats recency-true as live-session standing. Process occupancy is not visible there. Instructing PM/UX not to treat recency as Massive-live does not change what the desk shows. S3 / AC-13 require captured-research-day standing — not live, not live Massive — on the existing ticker. I will not drop that class or accept copy-only honesty.
conflicts.proposal: Keep one ticker live path (no second live path). While armed, that path must not occupy live-session standing. Recency of ticks is not provenance. Architecture chooses the consume-path fact that makes playing / end-of-captured-day / replay-fault / live-offline (unset arm only) observable without reading source.

conflicts.quote: End-of-tape / player drop degrades like an SSE gap (recency ages out); last Path-B snapshot remains.
conflicts.why: End of captured day is not Massive dropped and is not a stream gap (AC-19, AC-42). Recency aging into the existing gap/offline path is the live-offline standing. Lumping player drop with end-of-tape also collapses replay-fault into end. Last structure remaining is the part that stands.
conflicts.proposal: After the last stored occupant: no further Path-A, no loop, last structure may remain, standing is end of captured day. Clock/tape-read fault is replay-fault. Unset-arm vendor down is live-offline. Recency aging is not the end classifier.

conflicts.quote: Start on Path-A zero shows `no path-a ticks for {SYMBOL} on {ET_DATE}` and refuses the walk.
conflicts.why: Empty Path-A is a quiet stored day, not missing, not unreadable (AC-17). Path-A and Path-B walk independently (AC-22): present Path-B must still unfold when Path-A is quiet. Refusing the whole walk because Path-A is zero makes Path-A-empty stand in for ‘no Tuesday’ and blocks a Path-B-only day.
conflicts.proposal: Keep `no path-a ticks…` as the empty-tape class, distinct from missing and unreadable. If Path-B is occupied, the walk may start: zero Path-A prints, structure as the clock reaches stored marks. If both sides are empty, it is an empty-walk that ends without fabricated prints — still not a missing-tape refuse.

conflicts.quote: `/_ops/replay` is a **second unlinked operator route**, same chrome family as metrics (own AppBar, off `AppShell`, not in TopNav).
conflicts.why: Arming is process-start on a research/non-production serve, not a runtime flip, not an `/_ops` walker (Out, S7). Start/Stop on a running serve is that flip; I am not falsifying exclusive-construct to get an operator page. Ticker honesty while armed does not require a second surface.
conflicts.proposal: Process-start / CLI arm only this slice. No operator start/stop page. Miss, unreadable, ineligible, end, and fault copy still appear on the existing ticker while armed and on startup/CLI refuse. Operator lab UI and runtime re-arm stay Future.

conflicts.quote: Aggressive buys minus sells over the tape’s last few minutes, from stored Path-A trades.
conflicts.why: 4× and 10× compress waits; they do not restamp the day. A ‘tape’s last few minutes’ claim at those speeds is not the stored session’s last few minutes. That is a false walk of flow. I locked those speeds so a 16-hour tape can be sat through, not so copy can lie about the window. I am not adding a second flow clock this slice.
conflicts.proposal: At 1×, net-flow may keep a last-few-minutes read. At 4×/10×, do not claim tape minutes: keep the number without a tape-time window, or say it is compressed with the clock. No tape-time flow accumulator this slice.

conflicts.quote: Architect does not add a wire field; PM/UX must not treat recency-true as Massive-live.
conflicts.why: That sentence makes replay indistinguishable from live on the surface the desk already uses. Replay ticks **will** satisfy recency (`tick_age < 30s` wall). The ticker SSE envelope already sets `live` from that bit. The shipped client is `isLive = (live?.live ?? false) && !streamOffline`, and that boolean — not occupancy the page cannot read — gates `● live · ${session}`, `Streaming live ${feed} ticks.`, title `Live tape`, `Gamma flip (live)`, `liveDotPulse` / `widgetLivePulse`, and `evaluateOrder` fills. Process occupancy is not a field the UI consumes. Honest consume without a closed stream-basis on LiveUpdate is copy theater; recency-true is the paid-live classifier in chrome today.
conflicts.proposal: Keep StreamEvent stamp-only if needed. The existing ticker SSE envelope must carry a closed stream basis the client branches on before `live` / `feed` interpolation; replayed updates keep `live: false`. Named consume facts (not a new socket): basis = session tape; `et_date`; vouched tape time ET (do not relabel wall `ts` / `Date.now()` as tape time); phase `playing` | `ended`. Display-active may move headline/tiles/flash; `isLive` stays false so fills, live pulse, and live-session chip meaning stay off. Poison: a fixture with `live: true` and session-tape basis that still paints live chrome.

conflicts.quote: Recency (`last_tick_wall`) stays wall clock so end-of-tape still degrades in 30s of operator time.
conflicts.why: Stop-publish plus wall recency is the live-offline path, not an ended standing. The ticker watchdog is 15s of no payload (`STREAM_OFFLINE_MS`) → `⚠ Live offline — reconnecting…` / `OFFLINE_CHIP_TOOLTIP` (Massive reconnect). That fires before 30s recency and is a live-vendor claim the tape cannot carry. `live: false` without a vouched ended phase still falls through `liveStatus` to `○ overnight — no live data`, `○ market closed`, or `○ no live ticks` / “feed may be lagging.” Injecting tape-cursor `market_session` does not fix the chip if it still uses `liveStatus`.
conflicts.proposal: Emit a vouched `ended` phase on the same ticker contract and do not let heartbeat silence be the ended classifier. S1 copy stays `○ session tape ended · {SYM} · {humanSessionDate}`; last tape numbers kept; structure stays snapshot; never live-offline, never overnight-no-live-data. SSE drop during replay is a distinct `⚠ Session tape stream dropped`. Replay-fault is a third standing if the envelope names it; otherwise it must not reuse live-offline.

conflicts.quote: Start on Path-A zero shows `no path-a ticks for {SYMBOL} on {ET_DATE}` and refuses the walk.
conflicts.why: I cannot defend refuse-as-walk. No identity ≠ empty Path-A (`absent-is-not-none`). Architect starts EmptyWhileStoring with zero Path-A emits; PM locked a quiet walk. Refusing start renames a kept quiet day as missing. Fabrication is inventing ticks, not a clock that emits nothing. The `no path-a ticks…` line stays as empty standing, not a start-refuse.
conflicts.proposal: No-identity / unreadable / not-storing still refuse; ticker stays S0. Stored identity with Path-A count 0: clock may start; operator/CLI shows `no path-a ticks for {SYMBOL} on {ET_DATE}`; S1 may show session-tape chrome with `Last trade — no tape print at this tape time` and no fabricated prints. Path-B empty with Path-A present still warns `no path-b snapshots…` and may walk Path-A. Retract AC-U11 refuse; keep the literal.

conflicts.quote: `/_ops/replay` is a **second unlinked operator route**, same chrome family as metrics (own AppBar, off `AppShell`, not in TopNav).
conflicts.why: PM locked process-start arming, no runtime flip, no ticker play button, no second route, no `/_ops` walker. A Start page is operator chrome the BRIEF does not require. I already allowed S2 visual to drop under CLI-only. Keeping `/_ops/replay` as required is re-scope. Ticker honesty (S0/S1) does not depend on that route.
conflicts.proposal: No `/_ops/replay` this slice. Arming copy on the process/CLI twin (`session-day-replay` stdout + standing block; capture miss literals). No trader nav, no Settings toggle, no play/pause/scrub. S0 byte-identical when unset; S1 session-tape chip/widget/last-trade/fills split remains ship-blocking.

conflicts.quote: Exact English is UX; the closed standing class in AC-13/19/42 stays `test`.
conflicts.why: Standing class as `test` is right. Parking visible not-live wording as review-only (AC-14) leaves the live interpolations unguarded. `Streaming live ${feed} ticks.`, `● live ·`, `Live tape`, `Gamma flip (live)`, pulse, and fills follow `live.live` without a copy edit. That silently regresses; risk-based-verify is `test`, not exact-English review.
conflicts.proposal: AC-14 / AC-U28 stay `review` for approved standing prose (session tape, research playback, glossary). AC-U3, AC-U4, AC-U6, AC-U7, AC-U9, AC-U27 stay `test`: banned tokens `live` / `LIVE` / `live_massive` / `this quote is live` on S1; no `Live tape` / `Gamma flip (live)` / `● live`; end-of-tape ≠ live-offline; `isLive` false; poison `live: true` + session-tape basis. Do not move those rows to review in SPEC §3.

conflicts.quote: Path-A gap chip is `session tape gap · …` and does not use the live “feed may be lagging” tip.
conflicts.why: PathAGap has no `ts_ns` and is skip-emit. A ticker `session tape gap` chip with no vouched gap/phase on LiveUpdate is a label the consume path cannot support (defining failure). Inter-arrival waits are the clock, not a gap standing. Long silence still must not become live-offline (ended/drop conflict above).
conflicts.proposal: Drop S1 `session tape gap` as a required chip phase unless a vouched gap lands on the envelope. Keep the negative: do not use live lag / reconnect copy for a recorded Path-A gap. Occupancy/CLI may still record PathAGap. Retract AC-U8 as a ticker-chip `test` of that string; keep “no live lag tip” inside AC-U3/U7 if a gap phase appears later.

conflicts.quote: Standing includes **partial captured day**, never a full open-to-close claim.
conflicts.why: The negative is binding. The positive (“partial captured day” on the existing ticker) asserts completeness the LiveUpdate does not carry. No completeness field, no `{k} snapshots` health score, no “78% of Tuesday.” Printing partial on S1 is the same failure mode as printing complete.
conflicts.proposal: Walk what was kept (PM AC-26). Ticker never claims full open-to-close and never prints partial/completeness %. Chip is `session tape · {SYM} · {humanSessionDate} · tape {time} ET` plus locked `{n}×` if armed. Operator/CLI may reuse capture occupancy. Ban “complete open-to-close” in S1/S2 copy.
